China Visa Guide v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides easy-to-follow, step-by-step visual workflows for tourist, business, and work visas.
- Includes real-world case studies detailing successful applications, rejections, and solutions.
- Offers comprehensive FAQs addressing common visa application challenges.
- Features practical checklists, rejection recovery strategies, and city/port-specific entry tips.
- Focuses on actionable advice for both first-time and urgent visa applicants.
